# Interactive Stylized Water

This folder contains the imported Shader Graph, material, ripple texture and
support scripts from [Interactive Stylized Water](https://github.com/mozankatip/InteractiveStylizedWater).
The game scene currently uses its earlier `GestureFistGame/InteractiveWater`
material because that version matched the accepted look better. The imported E
package is retained in the project for later comparison and study.

The upstream repository is published under the MIT License. The full license
text is kept in `LICENSE` beside these files.
